units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 2:4">Maas. Sh. II, 4</cite> <he>יתחלקו לעסות</he> (Ms. M. <he>לעסיות</he>; Y. ed. <he>לעיסיות</he>) let them be divided into small portions to be used for leaven. Y. Ḥall. I, 57ᵇ <he>עירס ראשי עיסיות</he> if a person worked up (in the trough) morsels of dough for leaven. Ib. bot. <he>חמש עי׳</he> five morsels &c.; a. e.
